status_effects.explanation: His detachment is locally credited with a clearer, more incisive judgment than the patriotic crowd's, elevating his rhetorical standing.
His ostensibly political germanophilia is reframed as rooted in personal erotic idiosyncrasy, mildly undercutting the seriousness of his stance.

appraisal_events.evidence: Il était très fin... Charlus relevait avec finesse chaque faux raisonnement des patriotes.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator credits Charlus's detachment from patriotism with giving him a sharper, undeceived judgment, able to expose the fallacies of patriotic 'sots' where they cannot see their own.

appraisal_events.evidence: il la devait, et par une réaction très bizarre, à son « charlisme »... l'homme qu'il aimait lui apparaissait comme un délicieux bourreau.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator traces Charlus's germanophile sympathies to an idiosyncratic erotic sensibility (attraction to cruelty and to Anglo-Saxon beauty, revulsion at Germans as too close to his own blood) rather than to reasoned conviction, quietly deflating the seriousness of his political stance.
